The immediate (depth 1) dependents are auth‑gateway, batch‑exporter‑service, cart‑service, email‑sender, graphql‑federation, identity‑provider, inventory‑api, session‑cache, and storage‑cluster. Services at depth 2 include api‑gateway, billing‑worker, catalog‑db, customer‑portal, event‑stream, fraud‑detection, kms‑vault, mobile‑app‑backend, model‑registry, notification‑dispatcher, notifier, payment‑vault, rate‑limiter, recommendation‑api, search‑index, shipping‑calculator, sms‑gateway, tax‑calculator, template‑renderer, user‑preferences, video‑streamer, and web‑frontend. Deeper impacts (depth 3‑4) reach analytics‑pipeline, audit‑logger, checkout‑api, feature‑store, ledger, legacy‑reports, push‑relay, order‑service, and secret‑manager. (See blast‑radius edge IDs EID‑BG‑00177, EID‑BG‑00173, EID‑BG‑00165, EID‑BG‑00153, EID‑BG‑00147, EID‑BG‑00132, EID‑BG‑00113, EID‑BG‑00066, EID‑BG‑00064, EID‑BG‑00025, …). 

Assignment path: The service is owned by **team‑payments** (catalog record) and the current on‑call responder is **person‑frontend‑lead**. This ownership and on‑call assignment have been verified with a valid path‑verification pass.

Thus, the impact is broad across many core platform services, and the trustworthy assignment path points to team‑payments (on‑call person‑frontend‑lead). Gate requires escalation to keystone-fixed-contact.
